title: 023 - Format Date
prompt: Fix the bug so the program format the sample date as 2026-04-01 and prints exactly `2026-04-01`. Keep the sample data and do not add extra output.
brokenCode:
<?php

function formatDate(string $text, string $query): bool
{
    return str_contains($text, strtolower($query));
}
solutionCode:
<?php

function formatDate(string $text, string $query): bool
{
    return str_contains(strtolower($text), strtolower($query));
}
hint: The month and day need zero padding.
explanation: The broken formatter leaves single-digit month and day values unpadded. Padding both fields fixes the date string.
